_meta.what: Registry of all company discovery sources
_meta.why: Before searching for jobs, we find companies worth watching. These are the signals that surface great companies.
_meta.how: Each source has a folder under sources/. Drop a HAR capture there, run har_to_api.py, get a live feed of new companies.

sources.name: Y Combinator Company Directory
sources.why: Every YC company is pre-vetted. Founders are top-tier. Investors are Tier 1 by definition. Filter by: batch=recent, remote=true, industry=AI/B2B/Hiring.
sources.api_hint: YC has a filterable JSON API powering ycombinator.com/companies. HAR will expose it.

sources.name: TechCrunch Funding & Startups
sources.why: Companies just announcing Series A/B are in active hiring mode. The press release comes the same day or day after the round closes.
sources.api_hint: TechCrunch uses WordPress REST API. HAR will show /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?categories=... calls.

sources.name: Inc42 — India Startup News
sources.why: Best source for India-first funded startups. Covers rounds that TechCrunch ignores. Signals remote-India-friendly companies.
sources.api_hint: WordPress REST API likely. HAR will expose it.

sources.name: The Ken — Indian Tech Journalism
sources.why: In-depth reporting on Indian startups. When The Ken writes about a company, that company is making real moves. High signal-to-noise.
sources.api_hint: Subscription site. MHTML capture of article list pages may be needed.

sources.name: Product Hunt — New Product Launches
sources.why: AI products gaining traction on PH = real user demand + likely funded + small team = hiring soon. Filter: AI category, top 5 of day/week.
sources.api_hint: ProductHunt has a GraphQL API. HAR will show api.producthunt.com/v2/api/graphql calls.

sources.name: Hacker News — Who Is Hiring (Monthly Thread)
sources.why: Monthly 'Ask HN: Who is Hiring?' thread. Companies post directly. Remote + India-friendly roles common. High quality companies post here.
sources.api_hint: HN has a public Firebase API: hacker-news.firebaseio.com/v0/item/<id>.json — no HAR needed.

sources.name: Crunchbase — Funding Database
sources.why: Structured funding data. Filter: Series A+, last 18 months, remote-friendly, AI/ecommerce/hiring-tech. Use for enriching companies found elsewhere.
sources.api_hint: Crunchbase uses a REST API internally. HAR will show api.crunchbase.com/api/v4/searches/organizations calls.

sources.name: Antler — Global VC / Accelerator
sources.why: Antler has a strong India presence (Antler India). Portfolio companies are early-stage, well-vetted, often fully remote, AI-native.
sources.api_hint: Portfolio page likely uses a JSON feed or GraphQL. HAR will reveal it.

sources.name: Surge by Peak XV (Sequoia India)
sources.why: Peak XV (formerly Sequoia India) backs Surge cohorts. India-first, well-funded, top-tier investor signal automatically. Best for India remote roles.
sources.api_hint: Static or CMS-backed portfolio page. HAR may show a CMS API.

sources.name: LinkedIn — Funding Announcement Posts
sources.why: Founders announce their funding rounds on LinkedIn before or alongside press. These posts name the company, the round size, and often mention the team is growing. Same-day signal.
sources.api_hint: LinkedIn Voyager API: voyager/api/search/blended?keywords=raised+Series+A&type=CONTENT. HAR will show this.
search_queries: we are hiring after our raise

sources.name: Twitter/X — Founder Funding & Hiring Announcements
sources.why: Many founders announce rounds and hiring on X before anywhere else. Fast signal but noisy. Filter to verified accounts + min engagement.
search_queries: we're hiring PM product manager remote India
just closed our round AND hiring

sources.name: BetaList — Early-Stage Product Launches
sources.why: Pre-launch products = very early stage. Use only as a watchlist seed — monitor them until they raise a round, then evaluate properly.
